items.title: Compute the literal mixture transform by genuine joint Fubini

source.anchor: AppendixB2.2 H definition Ex56, Ex58, Ex59/Fubini paragraph, Ex60 and Eq21, with Eq4 and B6 as providers. Literal functions only.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. Joint-L1 and Fubini details are made explicit; compact prefactor is a disclosed sufficient alternative to the sharp Ex59 constant.

items.statement: Let n>=3, kappa>=4 and ell>=0. On full real O(n), use the existing normalized Borel Haar probability mu; on Euclidean real n-space use its actual norm and volume. Let A_O be the literal Eq4 precision and p_O(x)=sqrt(det A_O)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A_O x/2), with real n/2. Put U=O_11 and a(O)=kappa+1+4ell-(kappa-1)U. Both joint functions f(O,x)=det(O)exp(-ell||x||_2^2)p_O(x) and g(O,x)=det(O)sqrt(det A_O)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-a(O)||x||_2^2/4) are absolutely Bochner L1 under mu times Euclidean volume. Moreover the literal nested transform E[det(O) integral exp(-ell||x||_2^2)p_O(x) dx] equals (-1)^(n-1)(sqrt(kappa)-1)^(n-1)/2^(n/2) times E[((sqrt(kappa)+1)U-(sqrt(kappa)-1))/a(O)^(n/2)]. This includes ell=0. It is an equality for explicit real formulas, without identifying p with an actual Gaussian density or the transform with target-mixture expectations.
assumptions: Standing n>=3 and kappa>=4, and source ell>=0 including zero. All dimension-half powers use real division.

The same actual canonical normalized full O(n) Haar law is used, with both determinant signs, and the spatial measure is actual Euclidean volume. WithLp.ofLp supplies coordinates without replacing the Euclidean norm.

Original and radial joint absolute L1 are theorem conclusions. Spectral lower bounds, Haar probability, compact prefactor bounds, Gaussian decay integrability and both Fubini swaps are supplied internally. No L1, domination, density-identification or Fubini premise is added.

Source Ex59 has explicit sharp prefactor (kappa/(2pi))^(n/2). This proof uses a sufficient finite compact prefactor depending on n and kappa. It proves the same exact integration identity, without separately claiming the sharp Ex59 estimate.

obligations.label: Genuine original/radial joint L1 and exact literal H transform

bindings.boundary: Joint original/radial Haar-spatial L1 and the literal H integral through Eq21 are proved. Actual Gaussian law/density identification, normalization/covariance of that law and resulting target-mixture/TV meanings remain open. The sharp Ex59 constant remains source-only; a finite compact prefactor suffices here. Sphere/Poisson, parameter choice, TV/separation/amplification/transcript/eigenbasis and both main lower bounds remain open.

assumption_deltas.source: Standing n>=3,kappa>=4, ell>=0, full Haar O(n), Euclidean volume and source Ex58/Ex59/Fubini/Gaussian/B6 calculation.
assumption_deltas.lean: Same range and measures, no caller joint L1/majorant premise. Explicit literal-formula transform only. Finite compact prefactor supplies sufficient domination rather than separately proving sharp Ex59 constant.
assumption_deltas.reason: The exact scalar identity is unchanged for the isolated literal functions. Alternative finite domination proves the required absolute joint L1 without new hypotheses. Actual Gaussian-density and mixture/TV identifications are explicit exclusions, not claimed formalized.
